requirement: Create a risk factor linking a pathogen to a criterion: both must exist and be live, the pair must not already exist among live rows, then the command is mapped, persisted, and its id returned with Created status.

preconditions.text: The referenced pathogen exists and is live
The referenced criterion exists and is live
No live risk factor already holds the pair
A live risk factor already holds the pair
The referenced pathogen or criterion is missing or soft-deleted

inputs.text: Create request with an unknown criterion id
Create the pair for the first time
Create request referencing a soft-deleted pathogen
Create request referencing a soft-deleted criterion
Same criterion linked to a different pathogen
Create request for a pair that already has a live row
Create the pair again after the previous row was soft-deleted
Same pathogen linked to a different criterion
Create request with an unknown pathogen id

returns.text: Success with Created status and the new risk factor id
The risk factor is persisted with the requested pathogen and criterion
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Pathogen not found' error
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Criterion not found' error
Failure with BadRequest when the live pair already exists

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
